articles.summary: CLEVELAND , Dec. 31, 2025 /PRNewswire/ -- TransDigm Group Incorporated (NYSE: TDG) today announced it has entered into a definitive agreement to acquire Stellant Systems, Inc. ("Stellant" or "the Company"), a portfolio company of Arlington Capital Partners , for approximately $960 million in cash,
articles.title: TransDigm Announces Acquisition of Stellant Systems, Inc.
